relationships.subject: miR-206
relationships.evidence_quote: Studies show that miR-206 promotes myoblast differentiation and regulates satellite cell proliferation by repressing Pax7, confining transgene expression to myogenic progenitors [105].

key_findings: Review: muscle reprogramming (transcriptional, epigenetic, metabolic) can limit denervation atrophy and fibrosis and support NMJ reformation after peripheral nerve injury.
Chromatin modifiers (HDACs, EZH2), Wnt/beta-catenin and TGF-beta contribute to the benefits; translation limited by delivery, safety and rodent-only data.
